items.title: Finland warns Ukraine war ‘spilling over’ after Baltic Sea drone strike on Russian cargo ship
items.brief: A Russian cargo ship with links to the military was hit by drones and caught fire in the Baltic Sea on Saturday in what Finland said was likely an attack by Ukraine, and the vessel later drifted into Finnish waters.

items.title: Russian ‘triple-tap’ attack in Ukraine kills emergency worker and 7-year-old in Zelensky’s home city
items.brief: A seven-year-old boy and a 20-year-old paramedic were killed Friday night in a Russian “triple-tap” strike on the Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih , according to local authorities.

items.title: Judge halts Army’s plan to detonate 5 tons of bomb-making material as Iowa residents worry about lead exposure
items.brief: A federal judge has ordered the US Army to pause its plans to detonate five tons of lead azide on Monday after environmental activists filed a lawsuit expressing concerns about the potential impacts of the explosion.
